about.title: DayPage
paragraphs: 无需账户的本地笔记应用。可离线记录、阅读、搜索、导入和导出。安装版本以此设备显示的版本为准。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
paragraphs: 候选更新日期 / Candidate revision date: 2026-11-07
本次公开说明服务为待发布版本准备，备案与公开部署仍需独立完成；本文不表示服务已上线或新版本已发布。
本政策适用于由 Xiong Xinwei 提供的 DayPage 本地版 iOS 应用。旧版云端客户端和第三方服务有各自的数据处理范围。

privacy.title: 本地笔记
paragraphs: 无需创建 DayPage 账户即可记录、阅读、搜索、导入和导出。笔记、草稿、对话、照片、录音及其他附件保存在应用的本地文件中。DayPage 没有自营的笔记上传、云同步、广告、追踪或使用分析服务，不会自动把你的笔记发送给开发者。
相机和麦克风仅用于你主动发起的拍照和录音；拒绝权限后仍可使用文字笔记。通过“文件”导入时，应用读取你选择的文件夹并保存副本。系统备份、设备管理和你主动导出或分享的文件由对应的系统设置和接收方管理。

个人 iCloud 默认关闭。开启后，笔记和附件通过你当前 Apple 账户的 iCloud Drive 在设备间交换，由 Apple 的服务处理；这不是开发者运营的笔记云服务。对话、模型密钥、笔记关系和操作记录不在此同步范围内。配对 Apple Watch 可通过 Apple 的设备连接把文字和原始录音交给 iPhone；原始音频保留以便恢复。可选设备端转写需系统语音权限和可用语言模型，不会自动转用网络转写。后台传递和同步时间受系统控制。
位置默认不添加。只有你在写笔记时主动选择“添加位置”，应用才会请求使用期间定位权限，并获取一次当前位置。所选位置随草稿和笔记保存在现有文件中，可在保存前移除；新笔记不会自动继承位置。应用不进行后台定位，也不把位置发送给开发者或用于反向地理编码。主动导出笔记或开启个人 iCloud 同步时，位置会作为笔记元数据随文件一起传输。

privacy.title: 可选 AI
paragraphs: AI 需要你选择服务商、地址和模型；部分服务需要你自己的 API 密钥，并可能另行收费。测试连接会联系你设置的服务，不附带笔记。获取模型列表也会联系所选服务。
点击发送后，应用会把你的问题、必要的对话历史和界面显示的笔记上下文发送到你配置的服务。开启卡片工具时，AI 还可以在这次对话授权的笔记范围内搜索、读取笔记和受支持附件中提取的文字，并提出新建、追加、修改或关系建议。修改和关系只有在原生预览中经你确认后才保存；建议本身不会自动改写笔记。请在发送前检查选择范围，不要向不信任的服务发送私密信息。

privacy.title: 朗读
paragraphs: 系统朗读使用 Apple 的系统语音合成。若选择外部语音渠道并主动朗读，所选文字会发送到该渠道配置的地址，生成的音频返回设备播放。预览语音发送示例文字。录音不会因此自动上传或转写。

privacy.title: 第三方与密钥
paragraphs: 你选择的 AI 和语音服务商会按照自己的政策处理请求，包括网络连接信息、保存期限及模型训练用途。DayPage 无法替这些服务承诺不保存或不训练；请在使用前查看服务商政策。不同服务和地区的数据处理规则可能不同。
密钥保存在 iOS Keychain，按服务地址隔离。应用不会把它们写进笔记或反馈。可通过服务商提供的控制台或其他方式撤销密钥；切换服务、删除语音渠道或卸载应用不保证清除所有历史 Keychain 项目。应用不包含开发者提供的共享服务密钥。

privacy.title: 保留、删除和反馈
paragraphs: 你可导出笔记，也可将不再需要的记录移到废纸篓。废纸篓会保留记录和附件以便恢复，恢复后原始备份也会保留；应用目前不提供永久清空功能。卸载应用通常会删除其本地容器，但不会删除已导出的文件、系统备份或第三方服务已收到的数据；这些副本需要在各自位置管理。未导出的本地数据可能随卸载或设备丢失而丢失，请自行备份。
反馈草稿在本地编辑。主动分享时，内容会交给你选择的接收方；点击打开 GitHub 反馈页面时，草稿会通过页面地址传给 GitHub，即使尚未正式提交。正式提交的 GitHub issue 通常公开可见，请不要附上密钥、私密笔记或个人资料。

privacy.title: 公开应用说明
paragraphs: 此候选版本的隐私政策和关于与支持页面自带中英文内容，可离线阅读。只有点击“查看最新说明”才会向固定地址 https://daypage-api.cubxxw.com/daypage/v1/app-info.json 发送无正文的 GET 请求；启动、记录、搜索和打开设置不会触发此请求。失败时仍显示内置说明，可手动重试。

此服务拟由中国上海的阿里云基础设施托管，只提供公开纯文本，不接收笔记、录音、附件、反馈草稿、AI 配置、密钥、账户或持久设备标识。客户端不使用 Cookie 或登录凭据，不跟随重定向。连接必然涉及 IP 地址、请求时间和 TLS 等网络元数据，云基础设施仍会处理这些信息。接口拟关闭访问日志，正式开放前必须核验部署配置；这不代表云平台没有任何基础设施日志。此说明不承诺第三方日志的保存期限。备案允许并验证公开访问后才开放服务。

privacy.title: 联系与更新
paragraphs: 隐私问题可在“设置 → 关于与支持”查看帮助，再从侧栏“反馈”联系开发者。请只提供解决问题所必需的信息。主动打开 GitHub 支持或反馈网页时，浏览器会连接 GitHub，该网站的数据处理适用 GitHub 隐私声明 (https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)。政策更新会发布在此说明中；如数据处理方式发生变化，政策会相应更新。

support.title: 支持
paragraphs: DayPage 是无需账户的本地笔记应用。文字、照片、录音和附件保存在设备上；AI 对话和外部朗读需要自行配置服务，费用由相应服务商决定。
设置中的“隐私政策”和“关于与支持”提供离线说明。候选更新中的“查看最新说明”仅请求公开应用说明，失败不影响内置内容；国内服务须在备案允许并核验部署后开放，这不是已上线声明。此入口不上传反馈或笔记。
可选个人 iCloud 使用你的 Apple 账户交换笔记和附件；配对 Watch 可传递文字与原始录音。同步状态不保证 Apple 已完成云端上传。AI 提出的笔记和关系变更需你在原生预览中确认。
如需反馈问题，请在应用侧栏打开“反馈”，或前往 DayPage GitHub Issues (https://github.com/getyak/daypage/issues)。请提供应用版本、iOS 版本、复现步骤和预期结果。问题通常公开可见，请勿附上私密笔记、API 密钥、登录资料或未经处理的个人截图。
隐私问题请打开“设置 → 隐私政策”，并在反馈中说明具体疑问。请先导出备份，再进行卸载等可能删除本地数据的操作。

about.title: DayPage
paragraphs: An account-free local notebook. Write, read, search, import and export offline. The installed version is read from this device.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This policy covers the local iOS edition of DayPage, provided by Xiong Xinwei. Legacy cloud clients and third-party services have separate data-processing boundaries.

This candidate prepares a public information service for a future app version. Filing and public deployment remain separate gates; this document does not claim the service is live or that version has shipped.

privacy.title: Local notebook
paragraphs: You can write, read, search, import and export without a DayPage account. Notes, drafts, conversations, photos, recordings and other attachments are stored in local app files. DayPage has no developer-operated note-upload, cloud-sync, advertising, tracking or usage-analytics service. It does not automatically send your notebook to the developer.

Camera and microphone access is used only when you choose to take a photo or record audio. Text notes remain available if you decline. Import reads the folder you select and saves a copy. System backups, device management and files you explicitly export or share are governed by your system settings and the recipient.

Personal iCloud is off by default. Enabling it exchanges notes and attachments through your current Apple account's iCloud Drive, using Apple's services rather than a developer-operated notebook cloud. Chats, model keys, note relationships and operation history are excluded. A paired Apple Watch can send text and original recordings to iPhone through Apple's device connectivity. Original audio is retained for recovery. Optional on-device transcription requires system Speech permission and an available language model; it never automatically falls back to network transcription. Background delivery and sync timing are controlled by the system.

Location is off by default. Only choosing Add location while writing a note requests When In Use permission and a single current fix. The selected location is stored with the draft and note in existing files and can be removed before saving. A new note does not inherit it. The app does not collect background location, send it to the developer, or perform reverse geocoding. Explicit notebook export or personal iCloud sync includes this metadata with the note files.

privacy.title: Optional AI
paragraphs: You choose the provider, address and model. Some services require your own API key and may charge separately. Connection tests contact the configured service without notes. Fetching available models also contacts the selected service.

When you tap Send, your question, relevant conversation history and the note context shown in the interface are sent to the service you configured. If you enable card tools, the AI can search and read notes and extracted text from supported attachments within that conversation's authorized note selection, and propose creating, appending, editing or linking notes. Changes and relationships are saved only after your confirmation in a native preview; a suggestion does not automatically rewrite notes. Check the selection before sending and choose services you trust.

privacy.title: Read aloud
paragraphs: System speech uses Apple's speech synthesis. If you choose an external speech channel and start reading aloud, the selected text is sent to that channel's configured address and generated audio is returned for playback. Voice preview sends sample text. This does not automatically upload or transcribe your recordings.

privacy.title: Third parties and keys
paragraphs: Your AI and speech providers process requests under their own policies, including connection information, retention and model-training practices. DayPage cannot promise that those services do not retain data or train models. Review their policies before use; processing rules may differ by service and region.

Keys are stored in iOS Keychain and scoped to service addresses. They are not written into notes or feedback. Revoke keys through your provider's console or other supported process. Switching services, deleting a speech channel or uninstalling the app does not guarantee removal of all historical Keychain entries. The app does not include a shared developer-provided service key.

privacy.title: Retention, deletion and feedback
paragraphs: You can export your notebook and move records you no longer need to Trash. Trash retains records and attachments for recovery, and original backups remain after restoration. The app currently has no permanent-emptying feature. Uninstalling usually removes the local app container, but does not remove exports, system backups or information already received by a provider; manage those copies separately. Unexported local data may be lost if you uninstall or lose the device. Keep your own backups.

Feedback is drafted locally. Sharing sends it to the recipient you choose. Opening the GitHub feedback page sends the draft to GitHub in the page address, even before you submit an issue. Submitted GitHub issues are generally public. Do not include keys, private notes or personal information.

privacy.title: Public app information
paragraphs: This candidate's Privacy policy and About & support pages include Chinese and English content for offline reading. Only Check latest information sends a bodyless GET to https://daypage-api.cubxxw.com/daypage/v1/app-info.json. Launching, recording, searching and opening settings never trigger it. A failure leaves the bundled information readable, with manual retry available.

The planned service uses Alibaba Cloud infrastructure in Shanghai, China and serves public plain text only. It receives no notes, recordings, attachments, feedback drafts, AI configuration, keys, accounts or persistent device identifiers. The client uses no cookies or sign-in credentials and rejects redirects. Connections necessarily involve IP addresses, request times, TLS and other network metadata processed by cloud infrastructure. Endpoint access logs are intended to be disabled and deployment must be verified before public access; this does not mean infrastructure-level logging is absent. No third-party log-retention period is promised here. Public access requires filing permission and deployment verification.

privacy.title: Contact and updates
paragraphs: For privacy questions, read Settings → About & support, then contact the developer through Feedback in the sidebar. Share only the information needed to resolve the issue. Opening GitHub support or feedback pages connects your browser to GitHub, whose processing is governed by the GitHub Privacy Statement (https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). Policy updates will be published in this information and will reflect changes in data handling.

support.title: Support
paragraphs: DayPage is a local notebook that needs no account. Text, photos, recordings and attachments stay in local files. AI chat and external read-aloud services require your configuration; provider charges may apply.

Settings → Privacy policy and About & support provide offline information. In the candidate update, Check latest information requests public app text only; failures leave the included text available. The domestic service requires filing permission and deployment verification before public access; this is not a launch announcement. This action uploads no feedback or notes.

Optional personal iCloud exchanges notes and attachments through your Apple account; a paired Watch can transfer text and original recordings. Local exchange status does not guarantee Apple's cloud upload has completed. AI-proposed note and relationship changes need your confirmation in a native preview.

For help, open Feedback in the app sidebar or visit DayPage GitHub Issues (https://github.com/getyak/daypage/issues). Include the app version, iOS version, steps to reproduce and expected result. Issues are generally public. Do not include private notes, API keys, sign-in details or screenshots containing personal information.
For privacy questions, open Settings → Privacy policy and describe the specific concern in your feedback. Export a backup before uninstalling or taking other actions that may remove local data.
